messages:
eva: Quick sync on last night's alert (INC-2026-042). Detection was a suspicious KMS key usage from an ephemeral pod. Containment succeeded (isolated node + revoked token). Wanted to capture action items and owners so we don't lose them.

samir: Thanks. Short list please — I can take RBAC delta and patch.

natalie: I'll own audit log retention & validation. Found gaps in our stackdriver->s3 export pipeline during the window.

kevin: Can someone add me for KMS key rotation plan? I need to map which services use the key.

michael-oncall: incident-bot: detection alert at 2026-02-18T03:12Z for unusual kms:Decrypt calls from cluster-a.

ops-bot: automated note: ticket INC-2026-042 created, severity=P2, link: https://redir.example/t/INC-2026-042

eva: Action items I have so far:
- Owner: samir — tighten RBAC for service-account ephemeral-* (deadline: 2026-02-25)
- Owner: natalie — full audit export validation + missing log reingestion (deadline: 2026-02-22)
- Owner: kevin — inventory of services using prod-kms-key and rotate plan (deadline: 2026-03-01)
- Owner: michael-oncall — tabletop exercise for similar detection flows (scheduled by 2026-02-28)
- Owner: eva — update incident playbook with new detection triage steps (deadline: 2026-02-24)

samir: For RBAC I'll propose a minimal policy first, then lockdown. Draft snippet to test:
```
bindings:
  - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
    members:
      - serviceAccount:prod:ephemeral-worker@prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
``` 
I'll also add a deny-list for older SA names.

natalie: Audit question — how long should we keep KMS usage logs? Current default is 90 days in hot storage, 1 year in cold. Suggest 1 year hot for now given threat model. Thoughts?

kevin: 1 year hot sounds right for now. Also we should enable KMS key usage alerts on cross-region access — this would have flagged the event earlier.

michael-oncall: For tabletop: propose a 90-min session that walks detection->containment->comms->forensic artifacts. Invite lists: eng-security, eng-sre, ops, legal.

eva: +1 on invites. Natalie, can you own the forensic artifact checklist? Things we need: signed logs, node images, pod specs, gke audit bundles.

natalie: Yep. I'll start a checklist doc and link it in the ticket.

samir: One more: we should add a pre-merge linter that detects PRs that widen iam bindings to wildcard service accounts. Small rule: no `serviceAccount:prod:*` in infra PRs.

kevin: Also need to confirm KMS key policy — are there any external principals with decrypt rights? I saw one third-party vendor entry last year that might be stale.

eva: Good catch. Kevin, add 'vendor-principals review' to your inventory task.

ops-bot: reminder: please update INC-2026-042 with progress comments. Automated follow-up scheduled in 48h.

michael-oncall: We'll also log the tabletop action as an OKR subtask for eng-sre to implement improved alerting rules.

eva: Cool. I'll compile these into the RCA follow-up section and push to the ticket by EOD.

samir: If anyone needs me to pair on the RBAC test harness, ping me.

natalie: Linking two references for compliance: https://compliance.example/kms-logs-guidance and https://sec.example/retention-policy

kevin: Moving my calendar to schedule a rotation dry-run next week. Will post time.

eva: Thanks all. Closing note: primary goal is to reduce blast radius and ensure auditability. We'll reconvene in the tabletop and track in INC-2026-042. :thumbsup:
